stumbles.why: Muninn is never explained, and it's unclear what the `github` tool is or how it differs from `gh`. A reader who doesn't know the project can't tell what the guard recommends.

stumbles.quote: GitHub returns 403 when a session tries to create a release or a tag.
stumbles.why: It doesn't say what "session" means (an agent session?) or why GitHub refuses. A reader can't tell whether the 403 comes from a permission or token limit, or whether it is expected.

point: The commit extends the guard script so that it also blocks `gh api` POST calls to `/releases` and `/git/refs`, not only `gh release create`. It does this to catch calls that would hit a 403, and it adds 4 tests.
